description: This file contains the implementation of an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named AdminController for managing taxonomies within OrchardCore CMS. It includes actions for creating, editing, and deleting taxonomy items, with methods for hierarchy traversal and manipulation.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Controller for managing taxonomy items in OrchardCore CMS, including create, edit, and delete operations with hierarchy handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Displays the view for creating a new taxonomy term.

methods.name: CreatePost
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new taxonomy term and add it to the hierarchy.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Displays the view for editing an existing taxonomy item.

methods.name: EditPost
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing taxonomy item.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a taxonomy item from the hierarchy.

methods.name: FindTaxonomyItem
methods.description: Recursively searches for a taxonomy item by ID within a JSON hierarchy.

methods.name: RemoveTaxonomyItem
methods.description: Recursively removes a taxonomy item by ID from a JSON hierarchy.
